<?php

final class RuntimeIssue extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $position,
        string $message,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

function formatOutput(array $arguments, array $position): string
{
    $fmt = toString($arguments[0]);
    $out = '';
    $i = 0;
    $arg = 1;
    $n = strlen($fmt);
    while ($i < $n) {
        if ($fmt[$i] !== '%') {
            $out .= $fmt[$i++];
            continue;
        }
        ++$i;
        if ($i < $n && $fmt[$i] === '%') {
            $out .= '%';
            ++$i;
            continue;
        }
        $flags = '';
        while ($i < $n && str_contains('-0', $fmt[$i]))
            $flags .= $fmt[$i++];
        $start = $i;
        while ($i < $n && ctype_digit($fmt[$i]))
            ++$i;
        $width = (int) substr($fmt, $start, $i - $start);
        $precision = null;
        if ($i < $n && $fmt[$i] === '.') {
            $start = ++$i;
            while ($i < $n && ctype_digit($fmt[$i]))
                ++$i;
            $precision = (int) substr($fmt, $start, $i - $start);
        }
        if ($i === $n || !str_contains('discxo', $fmt[$i]))
            throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'invalid format');
        $conversion = $fmt[$i++];
        if (!isset($arguments[$arg]))
            throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'not enough arguments');
        $v = $arguments[$arg++];
        $numeric = str_contains('dixo', $conversion);
        if ($numeric) {
            $integer = toNumber($v);
            $digits = match ($conversion) {
                'x' => dechex(abs($integer)),
                'o' => decoct(abs($integer)),
                default => (string) abs($integer),
            };
            if ($precision !== null)
                $digits =
                    $precision === 0 && $integer === 0 ? '' : str_pad($digits, $precision, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
            $body = ($integer < 0 ? '-' : '') . $digits;
        } elseif ($conversion === 's') {
            $body = toString($v);
            if ($precision !== null)
                $body = substr($body, 0, $precision);
        } else {
            if ($v->kind === 'number' || $v->kind === 'strnum') {
                $code = toNumber($v);
                if ($code !== 10 && ($code < 32 || $code > 126))
                    throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'invalid character code');
                $body = chr($code);
            } else
                $body = substr(toString($v), 0, 1);
        }
        $missing = $width - strlen($body);
        if ($missing > 0) {
            if (str_contains($flags, '-'))
                $body .= str_repeat(' ', $missing);
            elseif ($numeric && str_contains($flags, '0') && $precision === null)
                $body = str_starts_with($body, '-')
                    ? '-' . str_repeat('0', $missing) . substr($body, 1)
                    : str_repeat('0', $missing) . $body;
            else
                $body = str_repeat(' ', $missing) . $body;
        }
        $out .= $body;
    }
    return $out;
}

function invokeBuiltin(string $name, array $args, array $position): AwkValue
{
    if ($name === 'sprintf')
        return vString(formatOutput($args, $position));
    if ($name === 'int')
        return vNumber(toNumber($args[0]));
    $s = toString($args[0]);
    if ($name === 'substr') {
        $start = toNumber($args[1]);
        $end = count($args) === 3 ? $start + toNumber($args[2]) : strlen($s) + 1;
        $start = max($start, 1);
        $end = min($end, strlen($s) + 1);
        return vString($end > $start ? substr($s, $start - 1, $end - $start) : '');
    }
    if ($name === 'index') {
        $needle = toString($args[1]);
        $found = $needle === '' ? false : strpos($s, $needle);
        return vNumber($found === false ? 0 : $found + 1);
    }
    return vString($name === 'toupper' ? strtoupper($s) : strtolower($s));
}

<?php

const KEYWORDS = [
    'BEGIN',
    'END',
    'function',
    'if',
    'else',
    'while',
    'for',
    'do',
    'break',
    'continue',
    'next',
    'exit',
    'return',
    'delete',
    'in',
    'getline',
    'print',
    'printf',
];

const BUILTINS = ['length', 'substr', 'index', 'split', 'sprintf', 'toupper', 'tolower', 'close', 'int'];

const PAIRS = ['+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%=', '^=', '==', '<=', '>=', '!=', '++', '--', '&&', '||', '>>'];

const ESCAPES = ['n' => "\n", 't' => "\t", '\\' => '\\', '"' => '"', '/' => '/'];

final readonly class Token
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $spelling,
        public mixed $value,
        public array $position,
    ) {}
}

final class SyntaxIssue extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $position,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }
}

function tokenize(string $source): array
{
    $tokens = [];
    $i = 0;
    $line = $column = 1;
    $n = strlen($source);
    while ($i < $n) {
        $ch = $source[$i];
        $start = [$line, $column];
        if ($ch === ' ') {
            ++$i;
            ++$column;
            continue;
        }
        if (substr($source, $i, 2) === "\\\n") {
            $i += 2;
            ++$line;
            $column = 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ($ch === '#') {
            $end = strpos($source, "\n", $i);
            if ($end === false)
                $end = $n;
            $column += $end - $i;
            $i = $end;
            continue;
        }
        if ($ch === "\n") {
            $tokens[] = new Token('newline', "\n", null, $start);
            ++$i;
            ++$line;
            $column = 1;
            continue;
        }
        $end = $i + 1;
        $value = null;
        if (ctype_digit($ch)) {
            while ($end < $n && ctype_digit($source[$end]))
                ++$end;
            $kind = 'number';
            $value = (int) substr($source, $i, $end - $i);
        } elseif (ctype_alpha($ch) || $ch === '_') {
            while ($end < $n && (ctype_alnum($source[$end]) || $source[$end] === '_'))
                ++$end;
            $word = substr($source, $i, $end - $i);
            $kind = in_array($word, KEYWORDS, true)
                ? 'keyword'
                : (
                    in_array($word, BUILTINS, true)
                        ? 'builtin'
                        : ($end < $n && $source[$end] === '(' ? 'function_name' : 'name')
                );
        } elseif ($ch === '"') {
            $value = '';
            while ($end < $n && $source[$end] !== '"') {
                if ($source[$end] === "\n")
                    throw new SyntaxIssue($start);
                if ($source[$end] === '\\') {
                    if (($end + 1) === $n || !isset(ESCAPES[$source[$end + 1]]))
                        throw new SyntaxIssue([$line, $column + $end - $i]);
                    $value .= ESCAPES[$source[$end + 1]];
                    $end += 2;
                } else
                    $value .= $source[$end++];
            }
            if ($end === $n)
                throw new SyntaxIssue($start);
            ++$end;
            $kind = 'string';
        } elseif (in_array(substr($source, $i, 2), PAIRS, true)) {
            ++$end;
            $kind = 'symbol';
        } elseif (str_contains('+-*/%^!><?:=()[]{},;$', $ch))
            $kind = 'symbol';
        else
            throw new SyntaxIssue($start);
        $tokens[] = new Token($kind, substr($source, $i, $end - $i), $value, $start);
        $column += $end - $i;
        $i = $end;
    }
    $tokens[] = new Token('end', '', null, [substr_count($source, "\n") + 1, 1]);
    return $tokens;
}

<?php

foreach (['lexer', 'parser', 'values_fields', 'builtins', 'streams'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
const SPECIAL_NAMES = ['FILENAME', 'FNR', 'FS', 'NF', 'NR', 'OFS', 'ORS', 'SUBSEP'];

final class StaticIssue extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $position,
        string $message,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

final class Transfer extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public ?AwkValue $value = null,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }
}

final class Analysis
{
    public array
        $functions = [],
        $rules = [],
        $functionTable = [],
        $globalNames = [],
        $bindings = [],
        $arrayNames = [],
        $statementLines = []
    ;
    private array $nodes = [], $errors = [];

    public function __construct(
        public array $items,
    ) {
        foreach ($items as $item)
            if ($item->kind === 'function')
                $this->functions[] = $item;
            else
                $this->rules[] = $item;
        foreach (SPECIAL_NAMES as $name) {
            $this->globalNames[$name] = true;
            $this->bindings['g:' . $name] = true;
        }
    }

    private function error(array $p, int $priority, string $message): void
    {
        $this->errors[] = [$p, $priority, $message];
    }

    private function resolve(object $node, ?object $function): void
    {
        $local = $function !== null && isset($function->parameterNames[$node->name]);
        $node->binding = ($local ? spl_object_id($function) : 'g') . ':' . $node->name;
        $this->bindings[$node->binding] = true;
        if (!$local)
            $this->globalNames[$node->name] = true;
        if (isset($this->functionTable[$node->name]))
            $this->error($node->position, 2, 'function ' . $node->name . ' used as variable');
    }

    public function prepare(): self
    {
        foreach ($this->functions as $f) {
            if (isset($this->functionTable[$f->name]))
                $this->error($f->namePosition, 0, 'function ' . $f->name . ' redefined');
            else
                $this->functionTable[$f->name] = $f;
            $f->parameterNames = [];
            foreach ($f->parameters as $p) {
                if (isset($f->parameterNames[$p->name]))
                    $this->error($p->position, 1, 'duplicate parameter ' . $p->name);
                $f->parameterNames[$p->name] = true;
            }
        }
        foreach ($this->items as $item) {
            $function = $item->kind === 'function' ? $item : null;
            $pending = [$item];
            while ($pending) {
                $n = array_pop($pending);
                $this->nodes[] = $n;
                if (in_array($n->kind, STATEMENTS, true))
                    $this->statementLines[$n->position[0]] = true;
                if (in_array($n->kind, ['name', 'array', 'parameter'], true))
                    $this->resolve($n, $function);
                elseif ($n->kind === 'call') {
                    $target = $this->functionTable[$n->name] ?? null;
                    if ($target === null)
                        $this->error($n->position, 3, 'undefined function ' . $n->name);
                    else {
                        $n->function = $target;
                        if (count($n->arguments) > count($target->parameters))
                            $this->error($n->position, 4, 'too many arguments to ' . $n->name);
                    }
                }
                array_push($pending, ...array_reverse($n->children));
            }
        }
        if ($this->errors) {
            usort($this->errors, fn($a, $b) => [$a[0][0], $a[0][1], $a[1]] <=> [$b[0][0], $b[0][1], $b[1]]);
            throw new StaticIssue($this->errors[0][0], $this->errors[0][2]);
        }
        $links = [];
        foreach ($this->nodes as $n) {
            if ($n->kind === 'array')
                $this->arrayNames[$n->binding] = true;
            elseif (in_array($n->kind, ['membership', 'delete', 'for_in'], true))
                $this->arrayNames[$n->array->binding] = true;
            elseif ($n->kind === 'builtin' && $n->name === 'split')
                $this->arrayNames[$n->arguments[1]->binding] = true;
            elseif ($n->kind === 'call')
                foreach ($n->arguments as $i => $arg)
                    if ($arg->kind === 'name')
                        $links[] = [$arg->binding, $n->function->parameters[$i]->binding];
        }
        $parents = [];
        foreach ($this->bindings as $binding => $_)
            $parents[$binding] = $binding;
        $root = function (string $binding) use (&$parents): string {
            while ($parents[$binding] !== $binding) {
                $parents[$binding] = $parents[$parents[$binding]];
                $binding = $parents[$binding];
            }
            return $binding;
        };
        foreach ($links as [$a, $b])
            $parents[$root($a)] = $root($b);
        $arrayRoots = [];
        foreach ($this->arrayNames as $binding => $_)
            $arrayRoots[$root($binding)] = true;
        $this->arrayNames = [];
        foreach ($this->bindings as $binding => $_)
            if (isset($arrayRoots[$root($binding)]))
                $this->arrayNames[$binding] = true;
        return $this;
    }
}

function arithmetic(string $op, AwkValue $first, AwkValue $second, array $position): AwkValue
{
    $a = toNumber($first);
    $b = toNumber($second);
    if (($op === '/' || $op === '%') && $b === 0)
        throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'division by zero');
    if ($op === '^') {
        if ($b < 0)
            throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'negative exponent');
        $result = 1;
        $power = $a;
        while ($b > 0) {
            if ($b % 2)
                $result *= $power;
            $b = intdiv($b, 2);
            if ($b > 0)
                $power *= $power;
        }
    } else
        $result = match ($op) {
            '+' => $a + $b,
            '-' => $a - $b,
            '*' => $a * $b,
            '/' => intdiv($a, $b),
            '%' => $a % $b,
        };
    return vNumber($result);
}

final class Engine
{
    private array $globalNames, $globals = [], $locals = [], $lines = [], $inputLines = [];
    private Record $record;
    public Streams $streams;
    private string $phase = 'BEGIN';
    private int $exitStatus = 0, $operandPosition = 0, $inputPosition = 0;
    private ?Operand $currentOperand = null;
    private ?RuntimeIssue $error = null;

    public function __construct(
        private Analysis $analysis,
        private array $options,
        private array $operands,
    ) {
        $this->globalNames = $analysis->globalNames;
        foreach ($this->globalNames as $name => $_)
            $this->globals[$name] = isset($analysis->arrayNames['g:' . $name])
                ? new AwkArray()
                : uninitialized();
        $this->globals = array_replace($this->globals, [
            'FILENAME' => vString(''),
            'FNR' => vNumber(0),
            'FS' => vString(' '),
            'NF' => vNumber(0),
            'NR' => vNumber(0),
            'OFS' => vString(' '),
            'ORS' => vString("\n"),
            'SUBSEP' => vString(chr(28)),
        ]);
        $this->record = new Record(fn($name) => $this->globalValue($name));
        $this->streams = new Streams();
        foreach ($analysis->statementLines as $line => $_)
            $this->lines[$line] = 0;
        foreach ($analysis->rules as $r) {
            $r->count = 0;
            $r->inside = false;
        }
        foreach ($analysis->functions as $f)
            $f->callCount = $f->activeCalls = $f->maxDepth = 0;
    }

    private function variable(string $binding): AwkValue|AwkArray
    {
        [$scope, $name] = explode(':', $binding, 2);
        if ($scope !== 'g')
            return $this->locals[count($this->locals) - 1][$name];
        return $name === 'NF' ? vNumber(count($this->record->fields)) : $this->globals[$name];
    }

    private function globalValue(string $name): AwkValue|AwkArray
    {
        return $this->variable('g:' . $name);
    }

    private function assignGlobalInput(string $name, string $text): void
    {
        $this->globalNames[$name] = true;
        $this->globals[$name] = inputValue($text);
    }

    private function subscript(array $expressions): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($expressions as $e)
            $parts[] = toString($this->evaluate($e));
        return implode(toString($this->globalValue('SUBSEP')), $parts);
    }

    private function location(object $n): array
    {
        if ($n->kind === 'name')
            return ['variable', $n->binding];
        if ($n->kind === 'array') {
            $key = $this->subscript($n->indexes);
            return ['array', $this->variable($n->binding), $key];
        }
        $index = toNumber($this->evaluate($n->index));
        if ($index < 0)
            throw new RuntimeIssue($n->position, 'negative field index');
        return ['field', $index];
    }

    private function read(array $location): AwkValue
    {
        return match ($location[0]) {
            'variable' => $this->variable($location[1]),
            'field' => $this->record->read($location[1]),
            'array' => $location[1]->read($location[2]),
        };
    }

    private function store(array $location, AwkValue $value, array $position): void
    {
        if ($location[0] === 'field')
            $this->record->write($location[1], $value);
        elseif ($location[0] === 'array')
            $location[1]->put($location[2], $value);
        else {
            [$scope, $name] = explode(':', $location[1], 2);
            if ($scope !== 'g')
                $this->locals[count($this->locals) - 1][$name] = $value;
            elseif ($name === 'NF') {
                $size = toNumber($value);
                if ($size < 0)
                    throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'negative NF');
                $this->record->resize($size);
            } else
                $this->globals[$name] = $value;
        }
    }

    private function evaluate(object $n): AwkValue
    {
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'number':
                return vNumber($n->value);
            case 'string':
                return vString($n->value);
            case 'name':
            case 'array':
            case 'field':
                return $this->read($this->location($n));
            case 'paren':
                return $this->evaluate($n->expression);
            case 'assignment':
                $location = $this->location($n->location);
                $value = $this->evaluate($n->value);
                if ($n->operator !== '=')
                    $value = arithmetic(
                        substr($n->operator, 0, -1),
                        $this->read($location),
                        $value,
                        $n->position,
                    );
                $this->store($location, $value, $n->position);
                return $this->read($location);
            case 'increment':
                $location = $this->location($n->location);
                $old = toNumber($this->read($location));
                $value = $old + $n->delta;
                $this->store($location, vNumber($value), $n->position);
                return vNumber($n->prefix ? $value : $old);
            case 'conditional':
                return $this->evaluate(truth($this->evaluate($n->condition)) ? $n->first : $n->second);
            case 'unary':
                $v = $this->evaluate($n->operand);
                if ($n->operator === '!')
                    return vNumber((int) !truth($v));
                $integer = toNumber($v);
                return vNumber($n->operator === '-' ? -$integer : $integer);
            case 'membership':
                $key = $this->subscript($n->indexes);
                return vNumber((int) $this->variable($n->array->binding)->has($key));
            case 'binary':
                $first = $this->evaluate($n->left);
                $op = $n->operator;
                if ($op === '||' && truth($first))
                    return vNumber(1);
                if ($op === '&&' && !truth($first))
                    return vNumber(0);
                $second = $this->evaluate($n->right);
                if ($op === '&&' || $op === '||')
                    return vNumber((int) truth($second));
                if ($op === 'concat')
                    return vString(toString($first) . toString($second));
                if (in_array($op, COMPARISONS, true)) {
                    $order = compareAwk($first, $second);
                    return vNumber((int) match ($op) {
                        '<' => $order < 0,
                        '<=' => $order <= 0,
                        '==' => $order === 0,
                        '!=' => $order !== 0,
                        '>=' => $order >= 0,
                        '>' => $order > 0,
                    });
                }
                return arithmetic($op, $first, $second, $n->position);
            case 'call':
                return $this->call($n);
            case 'builtin':
                return $this->builtin($n);
            default:
                return $this->getline($n);
        }
    }

    private function call(object $n): AwkValue
    {
        $f = $n->function;
        $local = [];
        foreach ($f->parameters as $i => $p) {
            $array = isset($this->analysis->arrayNames[$p->binding]);
            if (isset($n->arguments[$i])) {
                $arg = $n->arguments[$i];
                $value = $array ? $this->variable($arg->binding) : $this->evaluate($arg);
            } else
                $value = $array ? new AwkArray() : uninitialized();
            $local[$p->name] = $value;
        }
        ++$f->callCount;
        ++$f->activeCalls;
        $f->maxDepth = max($f->maxDepth, $f->activeCalls);
        $this->locals[] = $local;
        try {
            $this->statement($f->body);
        } catch (Transfer $t) {
            if ($t->kind === 'return')
                return $t->value;
            throw $t;
        } finally {
            array_pop($this->locals);
            --$f->activeCalls;
        }
        return uninitialized();
    }

    private function builtin(object $n): AwkValue
    {
        $name = $n->name;
        $args = $n->arguments;
        if ($name === 'length') {
            if (!$args)
                return vNumber(strlen(toString($this->record->zero)));
            $arg = $args[0];
            if ($arg->kind === 'name' && isset($this->analysis->arrayNames[$arg->binding]))
                return vNumber(count($this->variable($arg->binding)->elements));
            return vNumber(strlen(toString($this->evaluate($arg))));
        }
        if ($name === 'split') {
            $text = toString($this->evaluate($args[0]));
            $separator = count($args) === 3
                ? toString($this->evaluate($args[2]))
                : toString($this->globalValue('FS'));
            $array = $this->variable($args[1]->binding);
            $array->elements = [];
            $pieces = splitPieces($text, $separator);
            foreach ($pieces as $i => $piece)
                $array->put((string) ($i + 1), inputValue($piece));
            return vNumber(count($pieces));
        }
        if ($name === 'close')
            return vNumber($this->streams->close(toString($this->evaluate($args[0]))));
        $values = [];
        foreach ($args as $arg)
            $values[] = $this->evaluate($arg);
        return invokeBuiltin($name, $values, $n->position);
    }

    private function getline(object $n): AwkValue
    {
        if ($n->filename !== null) {
            $filename = toString($this->evaluate($n->filename));
            [$status, $line] = $this->streams->getline($filename);
        } elseif ($this->phase === 'END')
            return vNumber(0);
        else {
            $line = $this->nextRecord();
            $status = $line === null ? 0 : 1;
        }
        if ($status === 1) {
            if ($n->target === null)
                $this->record->set($line);
            else {
                $location = $this->location($n->target);
                $this->store($location, inputValue($line), $n->position);
            }
        }
        return vNumber($status);
    }

    private function output(object $n): void
    {
        $arguments = [];
        foreach ($n->arguments as $arg)
            $arguments[] = $this->evaluate($arg);
        if ($n->kind === 'print') {
            if (!$arguments)
                $arguments = [$this->record->zero];
            $text =
                implode(toString($this->globalValue('OFS')), array_map(toString(...), $arguments))
                . toString($this->globalValue('ORS'));
        } else
            $text = formatOutput($arguments, $n->position);
        $filename = $n->filename === null ? null : toString($this->evaluate($n->filename));
        $this->streams->write($text, $filename, $n->redirect, $n->redirectPosition);
    }

    private function loopBody(object $body): bool
    {
        try {
            $this->statement($body);
        } catch (Transfer $t) {
            if ($t->kind === 'break')
                return false;
            if ($t->kind !== 'continue')
                throw $t;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function statement(object $n): void
    {
        if ($n->kind === 'block') {
            foreach ($n->statements as $s)
                $this->statement($s);
            return;
        }
        if ($n->kind === 'empty')
            return;
        ++$this->lines[$n->position[0]];
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'expression_statement':
                $this->evaluate($n->expression);
                break;
            case 'print':
            case 'printf':
                $this->output($n);
                break;
            case 'if':
                $branch = truth($this->evaluate($n->condition)) ? $n->first : $n->second;
                if ($branch !== null)
                    $this->statement($branch);
                break;
            case 'while':
                while (truth($this->evaluate($n->condition)))
                    if (!$this->loopBody($n->body))
                        break;
                break;
            case 'do':
                do {
                    if (!$this->loopBody($n->body))
                        break;
                } while (truth($this->evaluate($n->condition)));
                break;
            case 'for':
                if ($n->initial !== null)
                    $this->evaluate($n->initial);
                while ($n->condition === null || truth($this->evaluate($n->condition))) {
                    if (!$this->loopBody($n->body))
                        break;
                    if ($n->update !== null)
                        $this->evaluate($n->update);
                }
                break;
            case 'for_in':
                $keys = $this->variable($n->array->binding)->keys();
                usort($keys, subscriptCompare(...));
                foreach ($keys as $key) {
                    $this->store(
                        ['variable', $n->variable->binding],
                        inputValue($key),
                        $n->variable->position,
                    );
                    if (!$this->loopBody($n->body))
                        break;
                }
                break;
            case 'delete':
                $array = $this->variable($n->array->binding);
                if ($n->indexes === null)
                    $array->elements = [];
                else {
                    $key = $this->subscript($n->indexes);
                    $array->remove($key);
                }
                break;
            case 'next':
                if ($this->phase === 'BEGIN' || $this->phase === 'END')
                    throw new RuntimeIssue($n->position, 'next used in BEGIN or END');
                throw new Transfer('next');
            case 'exit':
                if ($n->value !== null)
                    $this->exitStatus = toNumber($this->evaluate($n->value));
                throw new Transfer('exit');
            case 'return':
                throw new Transfer(
                    'return',
                    $n->value === null ? uninitialized() : $this->evaluate($n->value),
                );
            default:
                throw new Transfer($n->kind);
        }
    }

    private function nextRecord(): ?string
    {
        while (true) {
            if ($this->inputPosition < count($this->inputLines)) {
                $line = $this->inputLines[$this->inputPosition++];
                ++$this->currentOperand->records;
                $this->globals['NR'] = vNumber(toNumber($this->globalValue('NR')) + 1);
                $this->globals['FNR'] = vNumber(toNumber($this->globalValue('FNR')) + 1);
                return $line;
            }
            if ($this->operandPosition === count($this->operands))
                return null;
            $operand = $this->operands[$this->operandPosition++];
            if ($operand->kind === 'assignment')
                $this->assignGlobalInput($operand->name, $operand->value);
            else {
                $this->currentOperand = $operand;
                $this->inputLines = readRecords($operand->name);
                $this->inputPosition = 0;
                $this->globals['FILENAME'] = vString($operand->name);
                $this->globals['FNR'] = vNumber(0);
            }
        }
    }

    private function runActions(string $phase): void
    {
        $this->phase = $phase;
        foreach ($this->analysis->rules as $r)
            if ($r->flavor === $phase) {
                ++$r->count;
                $this->statement($r->action);
            }
    }

    private function matches(object $r): bool
    {
        if ($r->flavor === 'all')
            return true;
        if ($r->flavor === 'pattern')
            return truth($this->evaluate($r->patterns[0]));
        if (!$r->inside && truth($this->evaluate($r->patterns[0])))
            $r->inside = true;
        if (!$r->inside)
            return false;
        if (truth($this->evaluate($r->patterns[1])))
            $r->inside = false;
        return true;
    }

    private function runRecords(): void
    {
        if (!array_any($this->analysis->rules, fn($r) => $r->flavor !== 'BEGIN'))
            return;
        $this->phase = 'records';
        $rules = array_values(array_filter(
            $this->analysis->rules,
            fn($r) => !in_array($r->flavor, ['BEGIN', 'END'], true),
        ));
        while (($line = $this->nextRecord()) !== null) {
            $this->record->set($line);
            try {
                foreach ($rules as $r)
                    if ($this->matches($r)) {
                        ++$r->count;
                        if ($r->action === null)
                            $this->streams->write(
                                toString($this->record->zero) . toString($this->globalValue('ORS')),
                            );
                        else
                            $this->statement($r->action);
                    }
            } catch (Transfer $t) {
                if ($t->kind !== 'next')
                    throw $t;
            }
        }
    }

    public function execute(): void
    {
        try {
            foreach ($this->options as [$name, $text])
                $this->assignGlobalInput($name, $text);
            try {
                $this->runActions('BEGIN');
                $this->runRecords();
            } catch (Transfer $t) {
                if ($t->kind !== 'exit')
                    throw $t;
            }
            try {
                $this->runActions('END');
            } catch (Transfer $t) {
                if ($t->kind !== 'exit')
                    throw $t;
            }
        } catch (RuntimeIssue $e) {
            $this->error = $e;
        }
    }

    public function statistics(): array
    {
        $out = [
            $this->error === null
                ? 'status: exit ' . $this->exitStatus
                : 'status: runtime error at '
                . implode(':', $this->error->position)
                . ': '
                . $this->error->getMessage(),
            '[inputs]',
        ];
        foreach ($this->operands as $o)
            if ($o->kind === 'file')
                $out[] = "{$o->name} records={$o->records}";
        $out[] = '[getline]';
        foreach ($this->streams->inputs as $name => $s)
            $out[] = $name . ' ' . ($s->everOpened ? 'reads=' . $s->reads : 'missing');
        $out[] = '[rules]';
        foreach ($this->analysis->rules as $r)
            $out[] = implode(':', $r->position) . " {$r->flavor} count={$r->count}";
        $out[] = '[functions]';
        foreach ($this->analysis->functions as $f)
            $out[] = "{$f->name} calls={$f->callCount} depth={$f->maxDepth}";
        $out[] = '[outputs]';
        $s = $this->streams->stdout;
        $out[] = "stdout.txt writes={$s->writes} bytes=" . strlen($s->content);
        foreach ($this->streams->outputs as $name => $s)
            $out[] = "$name writes={$s->writes} bytes=" . strlen($s->content);
        $out[] = '[lines]';
        ksort($this->lines, SORT_NUMERIC);
        foreach ($this->lines as $line => $count)
            $out[] = "$line count=$count";
        $out[] = '[globals]';
        $names = array_keys($this->globalNames);
        sort($names, SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($names as $name) {
            $v = $this->globalValue($name);
            $text = isset($this->analysis->arrayNames['g:' . $name])
                ? 'array (' . count($v->elements) . ')'
                : describe($v);
            $out[] = "$name = $text";
        }
        return $out;
    }
}

[$options, $operands] = parseArguments(file('input/args.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES));
try {
    $items = new AwkParser(tokenize(file_get_contents('input/program.awk')))->parse();
    $analysis = new Analysis($items)->prepare();
    $engine = new Engine($analysis, $options, $operands);
    $engine->execute();
    $stats = $engine->statistics();
    $streams = $engine->streams;
} catch (SyntaxIssue $e) {
    $stats = ['status: syntax error at ' . implode(':', $e->position)];
    $streams = new Streams();
} catch (StaticIssue $e) {
    $stats = ['status: error at ' . implode(':', $e->position) . ': ' . $e->getMessage()];
    $streams = new Streams();
}
$streams->save();
file_put_contents('output/stats.txt', implode("\n", $stats) . "\n");

<?php

const ASSIGNMENTS = ['=', '+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%=', '^='];

const COMPARISONS = ['<', '<=', '==', '!=', '>=', '>'];

const LVALUE_KINDS = ['name', 'array', 'field'];

const STATEMENTS = [
    'if',
    'while',
    'do',
    'for',
    'for_in',
    'print',
    'printf',
    'delete',
    'next',
    'break',
    'continue',
    'exit',
    'return',
    'expression_statement',
];

function node(string $kind, array $position, array $children = [], array $fields = []): object
{
    return (object) (
        [
            'kind' => $kind,
            'position' => $position,
            'children' => array_values(array_filter($children, fn($c) => $c !== null)),
        ] + $fields
    );
}

final class AwkParser
{
    private int $index = 0, $loopDepth = 0;
    private bool $function = false;
    private ?string $phase = null;

    public function __construct(
        private array $tokens,
    ) {}

    private function peek(): Token
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->index];
    }

    private function take(): Token
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->index++];
    }

    private function fail(?array $p = null): never
    {
        throw new SyntaxIssue($p ?? $this->peek()->position);
    }

    private function accept(string $s): ?Token
    {
        return $this->peek()->spelling === $s ? $this->take() : null;
    }

    private function expect(string $s): Token
    {
        if ($this->peek()->spelling !== $s)
            $this->fail();
        return $this->take();
    }

    private function name(): object
    {
        if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'name')
            $this->fail();
        $t = $this->take();
        return node('name', $t->position, fields: ['name' => $t->spelling]);
    }

    private function newlines(): void
    {
        while ($this->accept("\n") !== null) {
        }
    }

    public function parse(): array
    {
        $items = [];
        while ($this->peek()->kind !== 'end') {
            if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ["\n", ';'], true)) {
                $this->take();
                continue;
            }
            $start = $this->peek();
            if ($this->accept('function') !== null) {
                if (!in_array($this->peek()->kind, ['name', 'function_name'], true))
                    $this->fail();
                $name = $this->take();
                $this->expect('(');
                $parameters = [];
                if ($this->peek()->spelling !== ')') {
                    do {
                        $p = $this->name();
                        $p->kind = 'parameter';
                        $parameters[] = $p;
                        if ($this->accept(',') === null)
                            break;
                        $this->newlines();
                    } while (true);
                }
                $this->expect(')');
                $this->newlines();
                $this->function = true;
                $body = $this->block();
                $this->function = false;
                $items[] = node(
                    'function',
                    $start->position,
                    [...$parameters, $body],
                    [
                        'name' => $name->spelling,
                        'namePosition' => $name->position,
                        'parameters' => $parameters,
                        'body' => $body,
                    ],
                );
                continue;
            }
            $patterns = [];
            if ($start->spelling === 'BEGIN' || $start->spelling === 'END')
                $flavor = $this->take()->spelling;
            elseif ($start->spelling === '{')
                $flavor = 'all';
            else {
                $patterns[] = $this->expression();
                if ($this->accept(',') !== null) {
                    $this->newlines();
                    $patterns[] = $this->expression();
                }
                $flavor = count($patterns) === 2 ? 'range' : 'pattern';
            }
            $this->phase = $flavor;
            if (in_array($flavor, ['BEGIN', 'END', 'all'], true) || $this->peek()->spelling === '{')
                $action = $this->block();
            else {
                if (!in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ["\n", ';'], true) && $this->peek()->kind !== 'end')
                    $this->fail();
                $action = null;
            }
            $this->phase = null;
            $items[] = node(
                'rule',
                $start->position,
                [...$patterns, $action],
                compact('flavor', 'patterns', 'action'),
            );
        }
        return $items;
    }

    private function block(): object
    {
        $open = $this->expect('{');
        $statements = [];
        while ($this->peek()->spelling !== '}') {
            if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ["\n", ';'], true))
                $this->take();
            else
                $statements[] = $this->statement();
        }
        $this->expect('}');
        return node('block', $open->position, $statements, compact('statements'));
    }

    private function condition(): object
    {
        $this->expect('(');
        $v = $this->expression();
        $this->expect(')');
        return $v;
    }

    private function loopBody(): object
    {
        $this->newlines();
        ++$this->loopDepth;
        $body = $this->statement();
        --$this->loopDepth;
        return $body;
    }

    private function terminator(): void
    {
        if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, [';', "\n"], true))
            $this->take();
        elseif ($this->peek()->spelling !== '}')
            $this->fail();
    }

    private function statement(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        $s = $t->spelling;
        if ($s === '{')
            return $this->block();
        if ($this->accept(';') !== null)
            return node('empty', $t->position);
        if ($this->accept('if') !== null) {
            $condition = $this->condition();
            $this->newlines();
            $first = $this->statement();
            $this->newlines();
            $second = null;
            if ($this->accept('else') !== null) {
                $this->newlines();
                $second = $this->statement();
            }
            return node(
                'if',
                $t->position,
                [$condition, $first, $second],
                compact('condition', 'first', 'second'),
            );
        }
        if ($this->accept('while') !== null) {
            $condition = $this->condition();
            $body = $this->loopBody();
            return node('while', $t->position, [$condition, $body], compact('condition', 'body'));
        }
        if ($this->accept('do') !== null) {
            $body = $this->loopBody();
            $this->newlines();
            $this->expect('while');
            $condition = $this->condition();
            $this->terminator();
            return node('do', $t->position, [$body, $condition], compact('body', 'condition'));
        }
        if ($this->accept('for') !== null) {
            $this->expect('(');
            $ahead = array_slice($this->tokens, $this->index, 4);
            if (
                count($ahead) === 4
                && $ahead[0]->kind === 'name'
                && $ahead[1]->spelling === 'in'
                && $ahead[2]->kind === 'name'
                && $ahead[3]->spelling === ')'
            ) {
                $variable = $this->name();
                $this->expect('in');
                $array = $this->name();
                $this->expect(')');
                $body = $this->loopBody();
                return node(
                    'for_in',
                    $t->position,
                    [$variable, $array, $body],
                    compact('variable', 'array', 'body'),
                );
            }
            $initial = $this->peek()->spelling === ';' ? null : $this->expression();
            $this->expect(';');
            $this->newlines();
            $condition = $this->peek()->spelling === ';' ? null : $this->expression();
            $this->expect(';');
            $this->newlines();
            $update = $this->peek()->spelling === ')' ? null : $this->expression();
            $this->expect(')');
            $body = $this->loopBody();
            return node(
                'for',
                $t->position,
                [$initial, $condition, $update, $body],
                compact('initial', 'condition', 'update', 'body'),
            );
        }
        if ($s === 'print' || $s === 'printf') {
            $this->take();
            $result = $this->outputStatement($t);
        } elseif ($s === 'delete') {
            $this->take();
            $array = $this->name();
            $indexes = null;
            if ($this->accept('[') !== null) {
                $indexes = $this->expressionList();
                $this->expect(']');
            }
            $result = node(
                'delete',
                $t->position,
                [$array, ...($indexes ?? [])],
                compact('array', 'indexes'),
            );
        } elseif (in_array($s, ['next', 'break', 'continue', 'exit', 'return'], true)) {
            $this->take();
            if (
                $s === 'next' && !$this->function && in_array($this->phase, ['BEGIN', 'END'], true)
                || $s === 'return' && !$this->function
                || in_array($s, ['break', 'continue'], true) && $this->loopDepth === 0
            )
                $this->fail($t->position);
            $value = null;
            if (
                in_array($s, ['exit', 'return'], true)
                && !in_array($this->peek()->spelling, [';', "\n", '}'], true)
            )
                $value = $this->expression();
            $result = node($s, $t->position, [$value], compact('value'));
        } else {
            $expression = $this->expression();
            $result = node('expression_statement', $t->position, [$expression], compact('expression'));
        }
        $this->terminator();
        return $result;
    }

    private function parenthesizedOutput(): bool
    {
        if ($this->peek()->spelling !== '(')
            return false;
        $depth = 0;
        for ($i = $this->index; $i < count($this->tokens); ++$i) {
            $s = $this->tokens[$i]->spelling;
            if ($s === '(')
                ++$depth;
            elseif ($s === ')' && --$depth === 0) {
                $next = $this->tokens[$i + 1];
                return in_array($next->spelling, [';', "\n", '}', '>', '>>'], true) || $next->kind === 'end';
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function outputStatement(Token $t): object
    {
        $arguments = [];
        if ($this->parenthesizedOutput()) {
            $this->expect('(');
            $arguments = $this->expressionList();
            $this->expect(')');
        } elseif (!in_array($this->peek()->spelling, [';', "\n", '}', '>', '>>'], true))
            $arguments = $this->expressionList(false);
        if ($t->spelling === 'printf' && !$arguments)
            $this->fail();
        $redirect = in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['>', '>>'], true) ? $this->take() : null;
        $filename = $redirect === null ? null : $this->concatenation();
        return node(
            $t->spelling,
            $t->position,
            [...$arguments, $filename],
            [
                'arguments' => $arguments,
                'redirect' => $redirect?->spelling,
                'redirectPosition' => $redirect?->position,
                'filename' => $filename,
            ],
        );
    }

    private function expressionList(bool $greater = true): array
    {
        $r = [$this->expression($greater)];
        while ($this->accept(',') !== null) {
            $this->newlines();
            $r[] = $this->expression($greater);
        }
        return $r;
    }

    private function expression(bool $greater = true): object
    {
        $left = $this->conditional($greater);
        if (
            in_array($left->kind, LVALUE_KINDS, true) && in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ASSIGNMENTS, true)
        ) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $right = $this->expression($greater);
            return node(
                'assignment',
                $op->position,
                [$left, $right],
                ['operator' => $op->spelling, 'location' => $left, 'value' => $right],
            );
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function conditional(bool $greater): object
    {
        $condition = $this->logical(0, $greater);
        $op = $this->accept('?');
        if ($op === null)
            return $condition;
        $first = $this->conditional($greater);
        $this->expect(':');
        $second = $this->conditional($greater);
        return node(
            'conditional',
            $op->position,
            [$condition, $first, $second],
            compact('condition', 'first', 'second'),
        );
    }

    private function binary(Token $op, object $left, object $right): object
    {
        return node(
            'binary',
            $op->position,
            [$left, $right],
            ['operator' => $op->spelling, 'left' => $left, 'right' => $right],
        );
    }

    private function logical(int $level, bool $greater): object
    {
        if ($level === 2)
            return $this->membership($greater);
        $op = $level === 0 ? '||' : '&&';
        $left = $this->logical($level + 1, $greater);
        while ($this->peek()->spelling === $op) {
            $token = $this->take();
            $this->newlines();
            $left = $this->binary($token, $left, $this->logical($level + 1, $greater));
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function membership(bool $greater): object
    {
        $left = $this->comparison($greater);
        while ($this->peek()->spelling === 'in') {
            $op = $this->take();
            $array = $this->name();
            $left = node(
                'membership',
                $op->position,
                [$left, $array],
                ['indexes' => [$left], 'array' => $array],
            );
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function comparison(bool $greater): object
    {
        $left = $this->concatenation();
        while (
            in_array($this->peek()->spelling, COMPARISONS, true)
            && ($greater || $this->peek()->spelling !== '>')
        ) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $left = $this->binary($op, $left, $this->concatenation());
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function concatenation(): object
    {
        $left = $this->additive();
        while (
            in_array($this->peek()->kind, ['number', 'string', 'name', 'function_name', 'builtin'], true)
            || in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['$', '(', '++', '--'], true)
        ) {
            $p = $this->peek()->position;
            $right = $this->additive();
            $left = node(
                'binary',
                $p,
                [$left, $right],
                ['operator' => 'concat', 'left' => $left, 'right' => $right],
            );
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function additive(): object
    {
        $left = $this->multiplicative();
        while (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['+', '-'], true)) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $left = $this->binary($op, $left, $this->multiplicative());
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function multiplicative(): object
    {
        $left = $this->unary();
        while (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['*', '/', '%'], true)) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $left = $this->binary($op, $left, $this->unary());
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function unary(): object
    {
        if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['!', '-', '+'], true)) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $operand = $this->unary();
            return node(
                'unary',
                $op->position,
                [$operand],
                ['operator' => $op->spelling, 'operand' => $operand],
            );
        }
        $left = $this->postfix();
        if ($this->peek()->spelling === '^') {
            $op = $this->take();
            $left = $this->binary($op, $left, $this->unary());
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function prefix(): object
    {
        $op = $this->take();
        $location = $this->lvalue();
        return node(
            'increment',
            $op->position,
            [$location],
            ['location' => $location, 'delta' => $op->spelling === '++' ? 1 : -1, 'prefix' => true],
        );
    }

    private function postfix(): object
    {
        if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['++', '--'], true))
            return $this->prefix();
        $left = $this->atom();
        if (
            in_array($left->kind, LVALUE_KINDS, true) && in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['++', '--'], true)
        ) {
            $op = $this->take();
            return node(
                'increment',
                $op->position,
                [$left],
                ['location' => $left, 'delta' => $op->spelling === '++' ? 1 : -1, 'prefix' => false],
            );
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function lvalue(): object
    {
        if ($this->peek()->kind === 'name') {
            $n = $this->name();
            if ($this->accept('[') !== null) {
                $indexes = $this->expressionList();
                $this->expect(']');
                return node('array', $n->position, $indexes, ['name' => $n->name, 'indexes' => $indexes]);
            }
            return $n;
        }
        $dollar = $this->accept('$');
        if ($dollar !== null) {
            $index = in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['++', '--'], true) ? $this->prefix() : $this->atom();
            return node('field', $dollar->position, [$index], compact('index'));
        }
        $this->fail();
    }

    private function atom(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if ($t->kind === 'number' || $t->kind === 'string') {
            $this->take();
            return node($t->kind, $t->position, fields: ['value' => $t->value]);
        }
        if ($t->kind === 'name' || $t->spelling === '$')
            return $this->lvalue();
        if ($this->accept('(') !== null) {
            $expressions = $this->expressionList();
            $this->expect(')');
            if (count($expressions) === 1)
                return node('paren', $t->position, $expressions, ['expression' => $expressions[0]]);
            $this->expect('in');
            $array = $this->name();
            return node(
                'membership',
                $t->position,
                [...$expressions, $array],
                ['indexes' => $expressions, 'array' => $array],
            );
        }
        if ($t->kind === 'function_name' || $t->kind === 'builtin') {
            $this->take();
            $arguments = [];
            if ($this->accept('(') !== null) {
                if ($this->peek()->spelling !== ')')
                    $arguments = $this->expressionList();
                $this->expect(')');
            } elseif ($t->kind === 'function_name' || $t->spelling !== 'length')
                $this->fail();
            $kind = $t->kind === 'function_name' ? 'call' : 'builtin';
            if ($kind === 'builtin')
                $this->checkBuiltin($t, $arguments);
            return node($kind, $t->position, $arguments, ['name' => $t->spelling, 'arguments' => $arguments]);
        }
        if ($this->accept('getline') !== null) {
            $target =
                $this->peek()->kind === 'name' || $this->peek()->spelling === '$' ? $this->lvalue() : null;
            $filename = $this->accept('<') !== null ? $this->atom() : null;
            return node('getline', $t->position, [$target, $filename], compact('target', 'filename'));
        }
        $this->fail();
    }

    private function checkBuiltin(Token $t, array $args): void
    {
        $n = count($args);
        $valid = match ($t->spelling) {
            'length' => in_array($n, [0, 1], true),
            'substr', 'split' => in_array($n, [2, 3], true),
            'index' => $n === 2,
            'sprintf' => $n >= 1,
            default => $n === 1,
        };
        if (!$valid || $t->spelling === 'split' && $args[1]->kind !== 'name')
            $this->fail($t->position);
    }
}

<?php

function validName(string $s): bool
{
    return preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/D', $s) === 1;
}

function validFilename(string $s): bool
{
    return preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/D', $s) === 1;
}

final class Operand
{
    public int $records = 0;

    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $name,
        public ?string $value = null,
    ) {}
}

function parseArguments(array $lines): array
{
    $options = $operands = [];
    foreach ($lines as $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, '-F '))
            $options[] = ['FS', substr($line, 3)];
        elseif (str_starts_with($line, '-v '))
            $options[] = explode('=', substr($line, 3), 2);
        else {
            $equal = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($equal !== false && validName(substr($line, 0, $equal)))
                $operands[] = new Operand('assignment', substr($line, 0, $equal), substr($line, $equal + 1));
            else
                $operands[] = new Operand('file', $line);
        }
    }
    return [$options, $operands];
}

function readRecords(string $name): array
{
    return file('input/' . $name, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES);
}

final class OutputStream
{
    public string $content = '';
    public bool $open = false;
    public int $writes = 0;

    public function append(string $text): void
    {
        $this->content .= $text;
        ++$this->writes;
    }
}

final class GetlineInput
{
    public bool $open = false, $everOpened = false;
    public array $lines = [];
    public int $position = 0, $reads = 0;
}

final class Streams
{
    public OutputStream $stdout;
    public array $outputs = [], $inputs = [];

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->stdout = new OutputStream();
    }

    public function write(
        string $text,
        ?string $name = null,
        ?string $mode = null,
        ?array $position = null,
    ): void {
        if ($name === null) {
            $this->stdout->append($text);
            return;
        }
        if (!validFilename($name) || in_array($name, ['stdout.txt', 'stats.txt'], true))
            throw new RuntimeIssue($position, 'invalid output file name');
        $o = $this->outputs[$name] ??= new OutputStream();
        if (!$o->open) {
            $o->open = true;
            if ($mode === '>')
                $o->content = '';
        }
        $o->append($text);
    }

    public function getline(string $name): array
    {
        $s = $this->inputs[$name] ??= new GetlineInput();
        if (!$s->open) {
            if (!validFilename($name) || !is_file('input/' . $name))
                return [-1, null];
            $s->lines = readRecords($name);
            $s->position = 0;
            $s->open = $s->everOpened = true;
        }
        if ($s->position === count($s->lines))
            return [0, null];
        $line = $s->lines[$s->position++];
        ++$s->reads;
        return [1, $line];
    }

    public function close(string $name): int
    {
        $closed = false;
        foreach ([$this->outputs, $this->inputs] as $table)
            if (isset($table[$name]) && $table[$name]->open) {
                $table[$name]->open = false;
                $closed = true;
            }
        return $closed ? 0 : -1;
    }

    public function save(): void
    {
        if (!is_dir('output'))
            mkdir('output');
        file_put_contents('output/stdout.txt', $this->stdout->content);
        foreach ($this->outputs as $name => $s)
            file_put_contents('output/' . $name, $s->content);
    }
}

<?php

final readonly class AwkValue
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public ?string $text = null,
        public int $numeric = 0,
    ) {}
}

function uninitialized(): AwkValue
{
    static $v = new AwkValue('uninitialized');
    return $v;
}

function vNumber(int $n): AwkValue
{
    return new AwkValue('number', numeric: $n);
}

function vString(string $s): AwkValue
{
    return new AwkValue('string', $s);
}

function numericPrefix(string $s): int
{
    return preg_match('/^[ \t\n]*([+-]?[0-9]+)/D', $s, $m) ? (int) $m[1] : 0;
}

function inputValue(string $s): AwkValue
{
    return preg_match('/^[ \t\n]*[+-]?[0-9]+[ \t\n]*$/D', $s)
        ? new AwkValue('strnum', $s, numericPrefix($s))
        : vString($s);
}

function toNumber(AwkValue $v): int
{
    return $v->kind === 'string' ? numericPrefix($v->text) : $v->numeric;
}

function toString(AwkValue $v): string
{
    return $v->kind === 'number' ? (string) $v->numeric : $v->text ?? '';
}

function truth(AwkValue $v): bool
{
    return $v->kind === 'string' ? $v->text !== '' : $v->numeric !== 0;
}

function compareAwk(AwkValue $a, AwkValue $b): int
{
    return $a->kind !== 'string' && $b->kind !== 'string'
        ? toNumber($a) <=> toNumber($b)
        : strcmp(toString($a), toString($b));
}

function subscriptCompare(string $a, string $b): int
{
    $x = preg_match('/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/D', $a) === 1;
    $y = preg_match('/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/D', $b) === 1;
    return $x !== $y ? ($x ? -1 : 1) : ($x ? (int) $a <=> (int) $b : strcmp($a, $b));
}

function splitPieces(string $text, string $separator): array
{
    if ($text === '')
        return [];
    if ($separator === '')
        return str_split($text);
    if ($separator !== ' ')
        return explode($separator, $text);
    return preg_split('/[ \t\n]+/', trim($text, " \t\n"), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

final class AwkArray
{
    public array $elements = [];

    public function read(string $key): AwkValue
    {
        return $this->elements['@' . $key] ??= uninitialized();
    }

    public function put(string $key, AwkValue $v): void
    {
        $this->elements['@' . $key] = $v;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return isset($this->elements['@' . $key]);
    }

    public function remove(string $key): void
    {
        unset($this->elements['@' . $key]);
    }

    public function keys(): array
    {
        return array_map(fn($k) => substr($k, 1), array_keys($this->elements));
    }
}

final class Record
{
    public AwkValue $zero;
    public array $fields = [];

    public function __construct(
        private Closure $special,
    ) {
        $this->zero = vString('');
    }

    public function set(string $text): void
    {
        $this->zero = inputValue($text);
        $this->fields = array_map(inputValue(...), splitPieces($text, toString(($this->special)('FS'))));
    }

    public function read(int $index): AwkValue
    {
        return $index === 0 ? $this->zero : $this->fields[$index - 1] ?? uninitialized();
    }

    private function rebuild(): void
    {
        $this->zero = inputValue(implode(
            toString(($this->special)('OFS')),
            array_map(toString(...), $this->fields),
        ));
    }

    public function write(int $index, AwkValue $v): void
    {
        if ($index === 0) {
            $this->set(toString($v));
            return;
        }
        while (count($this->fields) < $index)
            $this->fields[] = vString('');
        $this->fields[$index - 1] = $v;
        $this->rebuild();
    }

    public function resize(int $size): void
    {
        $this->fields = array_slice($this->fields, 0, $size);
        while (count($this->fields) < $size)
            $this->fields[] = vString('');
        $this->rebuild();
    }
}

function quoted(string $s): string
{
    $out = '"';
    $escapes = ['"' => '\\"', '\\' => '\\\\', "\n" => '\\n', "\t" => '\\t'];
    foreach (str_split($s) as $c) {
        $code = ord($c);
        $out .=
            $escapes[$c]
            ?? ($code >= 32 && $code <= 126 ? $c : '\\' . str_pad(decoct($code), 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT));
    }
    return $out . '"';
}

function describe(AwkValue $v): string
{
    return match ($v->kind) {
        'number' => (string) $v->numeric,
        'uninitialized' => '(uninitialized)',
        default => quoted($v->text) . ($v->kind === 'strnum' ? ' (strnum)' : ''),
    };
}
